name: Goal Insights (example)
description: Example plugin (opt-in) for plugin authors: shows how to receive goal lifecycle hooks. It adds no UI — each goal created or finished is written as one redacted line to this plugin's log (Plugins → Goal Insights → Logs).
author: cognia-next

zh-CN.manifest.name: 目标洞察（示例）
zh-CN.manifest.description: 面向插件作者的示例插件（需手动开启）：演示如何接收目标生命周期钩子。它不添加界面——每个目标的创建或完成都会以一行脱敏记录写入本插件日志（插件 → 目标洞察 → 日志）。
